test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 14th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: If the successive discounts are 5%, 10% and 16%, then find the single equivalent discount.
solution:
**Given:**

The successive discounts are 5%, 10% and 16%

**Concept: **If there are three successive discounts of a%, b% and c% on MP

SP = MP × ((100 - a))/(100)×((100 - b))/(100)× ((100 - c))/(100)

**Formula used:**

SP = MP&
